text: Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established.
study: The Hebrew root for 'commit' is 'gôl', meaning to roll or untrust. Esoterically, rolling the burden of outcomes onto the Infinite removes the friction of ego-driven fear that leads to over-trading. Action: Define your risk parameters clearly, then 'roll' the trade into the market's hands, refusing the temptation to hover or interfere.
